grade_rationale.text: The only page in the corpus that mentions the Krsnik is Machal (1918), in one sentence, so the entry rests on a single compiler.
Machal attributes the belief to one group only, "the Slavs in Istria", which the people table maps to Croatians.
Machal cites no collector or other source for the Istrian belief on this page, so no second independent source can be counted.
